scope: Static source-runtime reconciliation only; no WordPress/browser mutation.

source_runtime.direct_readback: Confirmed again from current main on 2026-09-15 before this correction.

manual_and_navigation_contract: manual is initialized once from c.classList.contains('carousel--manual') and is never reassigned.
start() calls stop() first, then creates a 4000ms interval only when manual=false, reduced-motion=false, slides>=2 and the carousel is connected.
Prev/next, dot, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and qualifying horizontal swipe call go(...) then start(); on a non-manual carousel this resets/restarts the autoplay countdown.
mouseenter/focusin call stop(); mouseleave/focusout call start() without independent pause flags.
prefers-reduced-motion changes call start(), so disabling reduced motion can restart autoplay on a connected non-manual multi-slide carousel.

broken_slide_contract_corrected.removal: drop(slide) removes the broken slide and corresponding dot, reindexes remaining data-go values and clamps/re-renders the current index.
broken_slide_contract_corrected.zero_remaining: When no slides remain, drop() calls stop(), hides the closest .project-card__extra/.hero-proof owner (or the carousel itself), then returns.
broken_slide_contract_corrected.one_remaining: When exactly one slide remains, drop() executes if(slides.length<2) stop() before go(...), so any existing autoplay timer is cancelled immediately.
broken_slide_contract_corrected.two_or_more_remaining: When at least two slides remain, drop() does not call stop() or start(); the existing interval is neither reset nor restarted by the removal itself, and go(...) simply re-renders the clamped current state.

disproved_stale_claims: v001 claim that drop() itself calls neither stop() nor start() in all cases
v001 caveat that reducing to fewer than two slides does not statically prove immediate timer cancellation
interaction v003 wording that drop() itself never stops/restarts a timer
acceptance_consequences: Do not deliberately break working media merely to exercise this path.
If a natural image failure reduces the source carousel to one or zero slides, source truth requires the existing autoplay timer to be stopped immediately.
If a natural image failure still leaves two or more slides, do not expect the timer countdown to reset solely because drop() ran; compare source/target observable cadence if relevant.
The corrected broken-slide contract is not evidence of a current target failure and does not authorize a runtime write.
Preserve the existing target runtime owner until a synchronized live failure is reproduced.
